title: Call Reach by Frequency
description: Production-style iDoXs report showing call reach by frequency with CTD and YTD side by side, including territory, district, region, and grand-total subtotals.

source.sql: with doctor_reach as ( select ltrim(rtrim(cast(d.REGION_ID as varchar(128)))) as region, ltrim(rtrim(cast(pi.DISTRICT_ID as varchar(128)))) as district, nullif(ltrim(rtrim(concat('(', ltrim(rtrim(cast(i.TERRITORY_ID as varchar(128)))), ') ', isnull(p.LAST_NAME, ''), ', ', isnull(p.FIRST_NAME, '')))), '(),') as territory, concat(ltrim(rtrim(cast(isnull(i.FREQUENCY, 0) as varchar(32)))), 'x') as frequency, pi.[MONTH] as period_code, i.MD_ID, count(i.VISIT_DATE) as visited from [dbo].[ITINERARY] i join [dbo].[PSR_ITINERARY] pi on i.TERRITORY_ID = pi.TERRITORY_ID and i.ITINERARY_DATE = pi.ITINERARY_DATE left join [dbo].[PSR] p on p.PSR_ID = pi.PSR_ID left join [dbo].[DISTRICT] d on d.DISTRICT_ID = pi.DISTRICT_ID where pi.[YEAR] = @fiscalYear and pi.[MONTH] <= @periodCode and isnull(p.TERRITORY_ID, '') not in ('RRICT') and ltrim(rtrim(cast(i.TERRITORY_ID as varchar(128)))) not in ('RRICT', 'TD') {{territoryPredicate:i.TERRITORY_ID}} group by d.REGION_ID, pi.DISTRICT_ID, i.TERRITORY_ID, p.LAST_NAME, p.FIRST_NAME, pi.[MONTH], i.MD_ID, i.FREQUENCY ), grouped_rows as ( select region, district, territory, frequency, grouping(region) as g_region, grouping(district) as g_district, grouping(territory) as g_territory, grouping(frequency) as g_frequency, sum(case when period_code = @periodCode then 1 else 0 end) as ctd_customer_count, sum(case when period_code = @periodCode and visited <> 0 then 1 else 0 end) as ctd_visited, sum(1) as ytd_customer_count, sum(case when visited <> 0 then 1 else 0 end) as ytd_visited from doctor_reach group by grouping sets ( (region, district, territory, frequency), (region, district, territory), (region, district), (region), () ) ) select top 10000 case when g_region = 1 then '' else region end as region, case when g_district = 1 then '' else district end as district, case when g_region = 1 then '**** GRAND TOTAL ****' when g_district = 1 then concat('**** ', region, ' sub-total') when g_territory = 1 then concat('**** ', district, ' sub-total') when g_frequency = 1 then concat('**** ', territory, ' sub-total') else territory end as territory, case when g_frequency = 1 then '' else frequency end as frequency, ctd_customer_count, ctd_visited, cast(case when ctd_customer_count = 0 then null else ctd_visited * 100.0 / ctd_customer_count end as decimal(18,2)) as ctd_percentage, ytd_customer_count, ytd_visited, cast(case when ytd_customer_count = 0 then null else ytd_visited * 100.0 / ytd_customer_count end as decimal(18,2)) as ytd_percentage, case when g_region = 1 then 'grand-total' when g_district = 1 then 'region-total' when g_territory = 1 then 'district-total' when g_frequency = 1 then 'territory-total' else 'detail' end as __rowType, case when g_region = 1 then 1 else 0 end as __sort_grand, isnull(region, '') as __sort_region, case when g_district = 1 and g_region = 0 then 1 else 0 end as __sort_region_total, isnull(district, '') as __sort_district, case when g_territory = 1 and g_district = 0 then 1 else 0 end as __sort_district_total, isnull(territory, '') as __sort_territory, case when g_frequency = 1 and g_territory = 0 then 1 else 0 end as __sort_territory_total, isnull(frequency, '') as __sort_frequency from grouped_rows order by case when g_region = 1 then 1 else 0 end, isnull(region, ''), case when g_district = 1 and g_region = 0 then 1 else 0 end, isnull(district, ''), case when g_territory = 1 and g_district = 0 then 1 else 0 end, isnull(territory, ''), case when g_frequency = 1 and g_territory = 0 then 1 else 0 end, isnull(frequency, '')

dataSourceDefinition.notes: Models legacy Call Reach by Frequency. For Cycle, match periodCode exactly. For YTD, include periods <= periodCode.

developerNotes.notes: Production-style Call Reach by Frequency. Uses single GROUPING SETS aggregation plus numeric sort flags so each territory subtotal follows its frequency rows, followed by district, region, and grand total.
